items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. With George Lewis? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, I see.

ctx.x: Like a blues? Huh? Like a blues, you see what it?

I mean, the band used to make their own name for the pieces. See, just like Lewis and them used to make it, called it Gut Bucket and all different kind of funny names. They had to have a name, so they just called it that name, but it was never published. You know what I'm saying? It was never published, the name or nothing. So we made a hit. And the people gave us a big hand, that band from the country, and they had a band from St. John Parish. They were good, too, at that time. I believe you should call them the…
